statement: If two numbers by multiplying any number make certain numbers, the numbers so produced will have the same ratio as the multipliers.
heath_proof: For let two numbers A, B by multiplying any number C make D, E; I say that, as A is to B, so is D to E. For, since A by multiplying C has made D, therefore also C by multiplying A has made D. [VII. 16] For the same reason also C by multiplying B has made E. Therefore the number C by multiplying the two numbers A, B has made D, E. Therefore, as A is to B, so is D to E. [VII. 17]
ai_proof_text:
7.18
**Statement:** If two numbers by multiplying any number make certain numbers, the numbers so produced will have the same ratio as the multipliers.

**Step 1.** Let A and B be two numbers, and let C be any number. Let A by multiplying C make D, and let B by multiplying C make E. We are to prove that A is to B as D is to E.

**Step 2.** Since A by multiplying C has made D, we also have C by multiplying A making D, for the product of two numbers is the same regardless of the order of multiplication [7.16].

**Step 3.** Similarly, since B by multiplying C has made E, we also have C by multiplying A making D and C by multiplying B making E [7.16].

**Step 4.** Now, C by multiplying A has made D, and C by multiplying B has made E. Therefore, since one number C by multiplying two numbers A and B has made D and E respectively, the numbers so produced have the same ratio as the numbers multiplied, that is, D is to E as A is to B [7.17].

**Step 5.** Therefore A is to B as D is to E. That is, if two numbers by multiplying any number make certain numbers, the numbers so produced have the same ratio as the multipliers. Q.E.D.
